summary.description: EVE lists the 25P as a 2.5Ah, 3.6V 18650 cell; its table gives a 12C maximum continuous discharge. Battery Mooch tested the exact EVE 25P and estimated about 15A true continuous current for the tested CCC-marked revision. A current UK specialist-vape retailer lists the exact cell for regulated-device use at 20A, but the runtime recommendation remains the lower independent estimate because the tested revision and thermal conditions matter. This record preserves exact-model evidence and unresolved revision caveats for the canonical catalog entry.
highlights: Exact model identity is documented; wrapper and revision continuity remain relevant.
Independent comparison current is preserved with its limitations.
Exact vaping relevance is supported by specialist retail and vaping-focused testing.
